topStories.headline: Global AI/Chip Selloff Deepens; Semiconductor Index Enters Bear Market, Down 20% from Record
topStories.summary: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index has fallen 20% from its all-time high, with SOXX down 10%+ week-to-date — driven by fears over AI spending ROI, DeepSeek's push to develop its own chips reducing Nvidia dependency, and Meta cutting reliance on third-party compute.
topStories.marketImpact: NVDA, AMD, INTC, SOXX, SMH ↓; Nasdaq leads broad market lower; worst week for semis since April 2025

topStories.headline: JPMorgan Posts Highest Quarterly Profit in US Banking History at $21.2 Billion
topStories.summary: JPMorgan Chase reported Q2 net income of $21.2B (+41% YoY) — the largest quarterly profit ever by a US bank; Goldman Sachs nearly doubled EPS; all five major banks beat estimates driven by surging trading revenues and investment banking fees.
topStories.marketImpact: JPM, GS, BAC, WFC, C ↑; earnings season off to historic start — 88% of S&P 500 reporters beating estimates

topStories.headline: Fed Rate Hike Odds Climb to 46.5% Ahead of July 28-29 FOMC Meeting
topStories.summary: CME FedWatch now prices a 46.5% probability of a 25bp rate hike at the upcoming FOMC meeting as oil prices climb on Iran tensions and inflation expectations firm; Bank of America now projects three additional 25bp hikes in September, October, and December.
topStories.marketImpact: TLT ↓ (yields ↑); USD ↑; rate-sensitive sectors under pressure; US 10Y at 4.55%, 30Y at 5.06%

topStories.headline: Nikkei Falls 4% into Correction; SoftBank -9%, Tokyo Electron -8% Lead Declines
topStories.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 closed at 64,141 Friday — down 4.03% on the day and 11% from its June record — as the global AI chip selloff swept through Tokyo with SoftBank sinking 9%, Tokyo Electron losing 8.1%, and Advantest falling 7.2%.
topStories.marketImpact: 9984.T ↓, 8035.T ↓, 6857.T ↓; Topix fell 2.72%; yen bid as safe-haven flows emerge

topStories.headline: Kioxia Loses $181 Billion in Market Value; Patent Ruling Compounds AI Selloff
topStories.summary: Japanese memory chipmaker Kioxia plunged 16% on Friday — now down 52% from its June peak — after a Texas federal jury ordered $229M in patent damages (Viasat claim), compounding its AI-era valuation unwind; Kioxia had rallied 600%+ from January's low.
topStories.marketImpact: 6600.T ↓↓; NAND memory segment under pressure; broader Japan tech sentiment severely hurt

topStories.headline: China Q2 GDP Slows to 4.3%, Weakest Since Late 2022; Politburo Meeting Eyed for Stimulus
topStories.summary: China's economy grew just 4.3% YoY in Q2, missing the 4.5% consensus and slowing from Q1's 5.0%; fixed-asset investment fell 5.7%; markets now look to the late-July Politburo meeting for additional stimulus signals with RMB6.8T in unused bond quota available.
topStories.marketImpact: Chinese consumer and property stocks ↓; stimulus watch — yuan and HK tech could rally on Politburo easing signals

topStories.headline: Hang Seng Drops 1.8%; SMIC Slumps 10% as US Chip Rout Hits Hong Kong
topStories.summary: The Hang Seng Index fell 446 points (1.78%) to 24,562 Friday, tracking the US semiconductor selloff; SMIC dropped 10%, Tencent fell 4.6%, Meituan and Xiaomi shed 2-4%; some capital rotated from hardware into internet names with Alibaba briefly outperforming.
topStories.marketImpact: 0981.HK ↓↓, 0700.HK ↓, 9988.HK mixed, 3690.HK ↓; mainland southbound investors remain buyers of AI hardware dips

topStories.headline: US-Iran Ceasefire Collapses; Oil Climbs Back Above $80 on Strait of Hormuz Attacks
topStories.summary: The US revoked Iran's 60-day oil sanctions waiver after ceasefire negotiations broke down; Iran's IRGC attacked tankers near the Strait of Hormuz; the US military shot down Iranian drones and sanctioned Iran's key oil-shipping networks; Brent crude surged 5%+.
topStories.marketImpact: XOM, CVX ↑; airlines and transport ↓; oil services watch; inflation expectations ↑; complicates Fed pivot narrative

topStories.headline: Alphabet and Tesla Headline a Packed Earnings Week; AI Capex Narrative in Focus
topStories.summary: 77 S&P 500 companies report Q2 this week; Alphabet (Wednesday) is expected to show 25.5% EPS growth on $116.9B revenue with its $190B AI capex guidance under scrutiny; Tesla (also Wednesday) faces questions on Cybercab ramp timing and China volumes.
topStories.marketImpact: GOOGL, TSLA watch; strong Alphabet results could partially stabilise tech sentiment mid-week; INTC reports Thursday
